sections.title: Quote-to-Booking
intro_paragraphs: How inbound freight enquiries become confirmed bookings, and where manual touchpoints slow the cycle.

workflows.name: Spot Quote Handling
today: Enquiries arrive by email and are re-keyed into a spreadsheet. Rates are looked up manually across three carrier portals, and the quote is assembled in Word.
Median turnaround is four hours; roughly a fifth of enquiries go stale before a quote is sent.
transformed: Enquiries are parsed automatically, rates are fetched via carrier APIs, and a draft quote is generated for one-click review.
Turnaround drops below fifteen minutes with an auditable trail per quote.

workflows.name: Booking Confirmation
today: Accepted quotes are confirmed by phone and rekeyed into the TMS, with occasional transcription errors surfacing at invoicing.
transformed: Quote acceptance triggers TMS booking creation directly; the customer receives a confirmation with tracking references within a minute.

sections.title: Proof-of-Delivery to Invoice
intro_paragraphs: The paper trail between a completed delivery and cash in the bank.

workflows.name: POD Collection
today: Drivers photograph paper PODs; back office chases missing ones weekly, delaying invoicing by an average of six days.
transformed: Digital signature capture at handover files the POD instantly against the shipment record; exceptions are flagged the same day.

workflows.name: Invoice Assembly
today: Invoices are compiled monthly from the TMS plus two side spreadsheets for surcharges, then checked line-by-line by hand.
transformed: Surcharges are captured at source and invoices are drafted continuously, cutting month-end close from five days to one.
